channel.title: NBC Sports Fantasy Football News
channel.description: Latest player news and analysis for fantasy football from NBC Sports.

item.title: Alex Highsmith (ankle) did not practice Wednesday.
item.description: Highsmith suffered an ankle injury in Week 11 and starts out the week not practicing. He was wearing an ankle brace in the team facility on Tuesday and head coach Mike McCarthy said it will be “tough” for Highsmith to play in a shortened Week 12 where the Steelers play the Broncos on Friday. Highsmith is trending in the wrong direction this week, but his ankle issue does not seem to be a major injury.-Aditya Fuldeore

item.title: Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) was limited in Tuesday’s practice.
item.description: Eagles DC Vic Fangio said today he believed Mitchell would be able to go, and it seems like he’s trending in the right direction after hitting the practice field today. It would certainly help anyone facing CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens out this week if Mitchell were able to go.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Dallas Goedert (shin) practiced in full on Tuesday.
item.description: That makes us feel pretty confident that he’ll suit up for Thanksgiving’s game against the Cowboys after a limited session on Monday. The Eagles’ passing game is in pretty rough shape with Joe Milton under center, but Dallas’ issues invite a TE1-capable game script for Goedert if the Eagles can take advantage of it.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Will Shipley (foot/illness) was limited in Tuesday’s practice.
item.description: With the news that Saquon Barkley is practicing in full, Shipley’s waiver wire appeal has downgraded drastically. He’s a reasonable stash and little more at this point in 12-team leagues.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Saquon Barkley (neck/illness) practiced in full on Tuesday.
item.description: It’s an upgrade over his limited session on Monday. Barkley told reporters after Sunday’s game that he doesn’t think he’ll ever get to 100 percent again for the rest of the season, saying “That’s not how football works.” But it seems like he’s at least “football healthy” enough to go against the Cowboys on Thanksgiving.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Pat Bryant (ankle) is practicing in full for Denver’s Week 12 game against the Steelers.
item.description: Bryant survived an injury scare on Sunday and this confirms that he should be in a good place to play on Friday. He took over as Denver’s No. 2 receiver against the Raiders, out-targeting Courtland Sutton 4-2, but wasn’t able to make much fantasy hay of the increased workload. Pittsburgh should be another game that mostly sees Bryant as a FLEX play at best.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Free agent WR Brandon Aiyuk will visit the Commanders on Wednesday.
item.description: Aiyuk’s last two days have gone pretty much exactly what you would have expected after the 49ers finally released him. He’ll likely sign with the Commanders practice squad officially tomorrow.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Broncos designated Tyler Badie (thumb) to return from injured reserve.
item.description: His 21-day window opens with a full practice. Seems like perhaps J.K. Dobbins’ suspension has accelerated the timeline on this decision, so Badie may have a chance to be activated for Friday’s game against the Steelers.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Roschon Johnson (ankle) did not practice on Tuesday.
item.description: We wouldn’t be surprised if he was an IR candidate after he was carted off during Week 11’s win over the Saints. Salvon Ahmed will likely take over third-string duties for the Bears.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Sam LaPorta (ankle) practiced in full on Tuesday.
item.description: LaPorta profiles as a TE1 option in a game with a juicy 55.5 over/under on Thanksgiving. This full session should assure that he skips the questionable line and proceeds directly to a fun game script in the early window.-Rivers McCown
